text:
Emma L: Heads up — AlderBank POC asked for SOC2/ISO artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation + confirmation on KMS separation for a Dedicated deployment. Also asked for a pricing note on Professional Services to scope network diagram and on-prem connector. Need an internal bundle by EOD Fri. cc @Raj P

Raj P: For pen-test letter they want: third-party test within last 12 months + short scope summary. We have a template but Legal needs to sign. @Maria S can Legal provide a signed attestation? Also they asked for staging IPs/ephemeral creds for a vulnerability scan.

Maria S: We can provide: redacted SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 cert, system description, and control narratives. We also have a standard pen-test attestation PDF — Legal prefers to deliver via Sales. KMS separation: for Dedicated we support BYOK / customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) but that requires onboarding + network review which affects pricing.

Ben K: Quick clarifying Q: is AlderBank asking for Dedicated (our VPC) or full on-prem? Need this to size infra/ops delta. If Dedicated, expect ~+30% baseline for reserved GPU pools and a one-time KMS HSM integration effort. PSS for network diagram + runbook is ~12-20 hours.

Emma L: They're evaluating Dedicated for residency/control, not full on-prem. They want the price delta and to confirm whether the pen-test letter will pass procurement. Customer flexible about final deadline by ~1 week; internal review still EOD Fri.

Raj P: I'll assemble a checklist and pricing stub. Draft checklist I'm planning to drop into the folder:

```
- SOC2 Type II (redacted PDF)
- ISO 27001 certificate (PDF)
- Pen-test attestation (signed letter from Legal)
- System description + control narratives
- Network diagram (high-level) + PSS SOW estimate
- Staging IP ranges + ephemeral scan creds
- KMS architecture note (BYOK/HSM options)
```

Maria S: Ops can provide staging IP ranges and a short KMS architecture note. For BYOK/HSM we need Legal + Infra sign-off — ETA Tue next week. Legal indicated they will sign the attestation after contract/PO confirmation.

Ben K: Preliminary pricing numbers for the stub: Dedicated baseline delta = +$8k/mo (estimate), KMS HSM integration (one-time) = $12k, PSS network diagram + connector runbook = ~$2.5k (fixed estimate). Will validate with finance and produce single-sheet.

Emma L: Great — @Raj P can you create the evidence folder and upload what we have? If Legal needs a PO, ping me and I'll chase procurement. I'll tell AlderBank we can get back by next Wed if needed. :thumbsup:

Raj P: Done — created folder https://redwood-internal.share/alderbank-poc-evidence . I'll upload artifacts as they come. Owners: @Maria S (security artifacts), @Ben K (pricing + infra note), @Emma L (customer updates).

deploy-bot: Security review workflow started for AlderBank POC (ticket #S-2289).

Maria S: Noted, will attach control narratives once the security ticket is in review and post staging creds when approved.

Emma L: Thanks everyone — sending the customer update now.
